# KaTeX (third-party, unmodified)

KaTeX 0.16.11 from npm (`https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.11.tgz`, sha1 `4bc84d5584f996abece5f01c6ad11304276a33f5`,
checked against the registry on 2026-10-09). Only `dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/katex.min.css`, the `.woff2` fonts and the
licence (MIT, see `LICENSE`) are kept. Used by Papurr to typeset formulas in notes (`mathElement` in `common.js`).

To update: replace this folder with the same files of a newer release and update this note; do not edit the files.
